base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT e.XCL_001
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = e.XCL_001
WHERE l.XCL_033 <= 29 OR l.XCL_033 >= 52
GROUP BY e.XCL_001
ORDER BY MAX(e.XCL_007) DESC
LIMIT 1;
